run_preprocess_questions: run the CLEVR questions preprocessing script to encode questions and programs into an HDF5 file
build_vocab_from_questions: build a vocabulary from CLEVR question JSON files using the preprocess script with --output_vocab_json
convert_program_to_prefix: convert a CLEVR program list to its prefix string representation using program_to_str with mode prefix
convert_program_to_postfix: convert a CLEVR program list to its postfix string representation using program_to_str with mode postfix
expand_existing_vocab: expand an existing vocabulary JSON with new words from questions using --expand_vocab with the preprocess script
